headline: India becomes ChatGPT's largest market by weekly users
quote: India has become ChatGPT’s largest market globally by weekly active users, with its local user base doubling since January 2026
claim: OpenAI India MD Prabhjeet Singh said India is now ChatGPT's largest market by weekly active users and the local base has doubled since January 2026. India is also among Codex's largest markets, with developer use from tier-II cities.
why_it_matters: Tools and free tiers get tuned for India first, and Indian developers are a core Codex audience.
title: India Becomes ChatGPT’s Largest Market Globally

headline: PowerUp Money raises $10M led by Flourish Ventures
quote: a wealthtech platform offering mutual fund advice and digital wealth management services, has raised $10 million in a funding round led by Flourish Ventures
claim: PowerUp Money raised $10 million led by Flourish Ventures, with Peak XV Partners, Accel, Blume Ventures and others participating. It claims over 1.5 million users track mutual fund portfolios on its platform.
why_it_matters: Shows funded demand for AI-led finance products in India, a domain where student builders can find problems.
title: PowerUp Money raises $10M to expand AI-led wealth management | YourStory

headline: Venomics AI raises $2.7 Mn pre-seed for venom drug discovery
quote: Biotechnology startup Venomics AI has raised $2.7 Mn (around ₹25.5 Cr) in a pre-seed funding round co-led by Speciale Invest and South Park Commons
claim: Venomics AI raised $2.7 Mn (around ₹25.5 Cr) in a pre-seed round co-led by Speciale Invest and South Park Commons, per Inc42.
why_it_matters: AI-for-biology is getting early Indian funding, relevant if you want research-flavoured startup work.
title: Venomics AI Raises $2.7 Mn To Turn Venom Into Medicine

headline: Indian startups raised $255 Mn across 20 deals this week
quote: Twenty startups cumulatively raised $255 Mn between November 2 and 6, up 96% uptick from $130.3 Mn raised last week.
claim: Inc42's weekly tally says 20 Indian startups raised $255 Mn between Nov 2 and 6, with deal count down 38% week-on-week.
why_it_matters: Funding is concentrated in fewer, larger deals, so seed-stage AI roles may be tighter.
title: From GIVA To EloElo Group — Indian Startups Raised $255 Mn This Week
